description: Condense the accreted changelog header of src/tmux/dispatch.ts into a compact current-design + not-closed-residue statement (comment-only).

userStories.title: Condense dispatch.ts leading comment header
userStories.description: As a future reader of src/tmux/dispatch.ts, I need the leading comment header to state the current design plus its not-closed residue compactly, so that I do not have to reconstruct today's design from an accreted CAM-358/CAM-359/CAM-364 changelog.
acceptanceCriteria: The superseded "Corrected model (review round 1 fix, US-R1-001)" changelog paragraph and the CAM-358/CAM-359/CAM-364 evolution/backstop-failure recounting are removed from the header, since that history already lives in scripts/cam/patterns.md. [oracle: ! grep -qF "Corrected model (review round 1 fix" src/tmux/dispatch.ts]
The "Residue NOT closed by this fix" honesty disclosure is preserved verbatim in the condensed header. [oracle: grep -qF "Residue NOT closed by this fix" src/tmux/dispatch.ts]

The condensed header still describes the CURRENT design: US-008 idle-guarantee send, US-002 post-send verify+retry, the CAM-364 prompt-row discriminator, the US-R2-001 reader-decoupling (visibleCaptureFn vs capture-pane -p -S - scrollback), and the CAM-375 send-once guard; it is materially condensed (superseded changelog narrative removed, not merely reworded) and drops no current-behavior content that patterns.md does not carry. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

The leading comment header is shorter than on main. [oracle: file-assert NOW=$(grep -n '^import ' src/tmux/dispatch.ts | head -1 | cut -d: -f1); BASE=$(git show main:src/tmux/dispatch.ts | grep -n '^import ' | head -1 | cut -d: -f1); [ "$NOW" -lt "$BASE" ]]

No line below the header (the first code line, `import { join } from 'node:path'`, and everything after it) is changed: the diff is comment-only. [oracle: file-assert git diff main -- src/tmux/dispatch.ts | grep -E '^[-+]' | grep -v '^[-+][-+]' | grep -vE '^[-+]\s*//' | grep -vE '^[-+]\s*$' | grep -q . && exit 1 || exit 0]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Single file: src/tmux/dispatch.ts. Header is lines 1-111 (blank line 112; first code line 113 is `import { join } from 'node:path'`), NOT ~89 as the issue title says. PRESERVE verbatim the residue disclosure at current lines 77-81. The reader-decoupling paragraph (US-R2-001, lines 83-96) and send-once-guard paragraph (CAM-375, lines 98-111) describe CURRENT behavior and are ABSENT from patterns.md (CAM-375 appears nowhere in patterns.md); fold them into the condensed current-design summary, do NOT delete them assuming patterns.md carries them. The CAM-358/CAM-359/CAM-364 superseded-model narrative IS already in patterns.md (:38, :889, :891, :897), so dropping it from the header is the intended 'relocation' -- no patterns.md write is needed and none is allowed. Nothing external references the header by line number (dispatch.ts:NNN citations point only at code below line 113), so renumbering the header breaks no references. Comment-only diff, zero behavior change, so no coherence rebuild is required despite dispatch.ts being sidecar-executed. Non-goals: no code/logic changes, no symbol renames, no edits below the header, no edits to patterns.md.
